svg.title: Behavioral nonlinear SSAE realized active-axis capacity

cc:Work.dc:title: Behavioral nonlinear SSAE realized active-axis capacity
cc:Work.dc:description: Realized independent-axis count and fraction of nominal capacity at the frozen 0.01 activity threshold. Means and population standard deviations are across training seeds. Every line is a nonlinear SSAE variant; Gemma and Pythia are not pooled.
